That tells me you're guiding the ball instead of attacking it — good swings can still be passive swings. Stay tall through the hitting zone and drive your back hip through the ball at contact, like you're trying to fire through the pitch, not just meet it.
fields.tip2: Swings 12 and 10 both came in at 5 and 9 degrees on strikes in the zone, and neither one got out past 159 feet. When your launch angle slips that low on good pitches, you're usually getting your hands out too early and rolling over. Feel like you're keeping your palm up through contact and finishing with the barrel staying through the zone longer before it climbs.
